newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK VOLUME, TURNOVER RISE.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK VOLUME, TURNOVER RISE.

text.p: Turnover and traded volume rose at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange, the exchange said.
Alkaloid joint stock company sold a total of 779 shares at 1,000 denars, unchanged from Thursday's close and below par of 2,424 denars.
Traded volume was 393 shares at the previous session on Thursday when only Alkaloid stocks traded at 1,000 denars.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
